avoid_when: Đệm hát ballad Việt — đây là gam jazz, không phải bài của thầy Hải Joseph

output.source_text: Resolution Rule 1: Sus chords are open/unresolved because they lack a defining 3rd (neither major nor minor). A common resolution is resolving down a 5th (e.g. Csus resolving to F).

note_vi: Bài 24 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 03:36-04:17. Resolution Rule 1: Sus chords are open/unresolved because they lack a defining 3rd (neither major nor minor).
